scientific_integrity: All six candidates and exhaustive finite coverage reproduced via two independently formulated exhaustive arithmetic enumerations; no claim of external validation.
scientific_limitations: Depends on the published global binary-weight product bound; the finite verifier is exact but does not reprove that bound. Only positive odd factors and the symmetric (3,3,3) case are classified. Earlier implicit derivations cannot be excluded.
title: Six solutions of the symmetric three-bit product problem
